title: AutoPlay sequence
description: sequences/<sequence-id>.json: an ordered list of steps (clicks, waits, other sequences).

name.description: Display name, unique among the sequences of the profile (ignoring case).

repeatCount.description: Number of times the steps are executed; 0 means until stopped.

step.description: One action. Click: clicks a location (screenId, locationId, delay before the click, verification). Wait: waits a random duration (delay, required). RunSequence: runs another sequence (sequenceId). Properties that do not apply to the kind are ignored.

delay.description: Click: random delay before the click, null to use the screen's default delay. Wait: the duration.

verificationTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the location, in milliseconds; null to use the profile default.

verify.description: Whether the template image must be found before clicking.

sequenceId.description: RunSequence: the sequence to run; null for other kinds.
